name: Madhuri Singh

about: I am pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, advised by Dr. Mark Riedl at the Georgia Institute of Technology. My research aims to make AI systems Explainable to AI-experts and non-experts alike. I am particularly interested in Explainable Reinforcement Learning and Agentic Systems.
